note: SNG-223: per-tradition visual-prompt guidance so a craft's generated image READS as its tradition (Ashwarden crafts look Ashwarden, Wright crafts look Wright). Built ON TOP of each tradition's canon `aesthetic` field in traditions.json (never replacing it) - this translates that prose aesthetic into image-generator language: palette, materials, light, mood. CCode's ensureImage('ability') prompt (SNG-223) prepends the craft's tradition block here to the craft's own authored description. Aevi-authored 2026-07-22.
usage: For a craft of tradition T: image_prompt = <craft.description> + ', in the visual style of ' + traditions[T].{palette, materials, light, mood}. The craft's OWN description is the subject; this is the STYLE wrapper so the whole tradition coheres. ⛔ SNG-367 — FOR A PERSON of tradition T: the `people` field is the SUBJECT guidance (build, bearing, dress, what they carry, what the craft has done to the body) and palette/light/mood are the STYLE wrapper. ⚠️ WITHOUT `people`, npcPromptSeed falls through formOf() to the literal string 'a person' — measured: 33 of 34 NPCs in Silas Weir's registry have no `appearance`, so every one of them was being drawn from 'a person, character portrait, named X'. That is why every figure rendered as the same young dark-haired woman. ⚠️ AND `people` DESCRIBES A HUMAN OF THE TRADITION — it is a style layer, never a species claim. A non-human figure must carry its own `form`, which wins over this; an Ent of the Rootkin is an Ent first.

umbral.name: The Umbrals
umbral.canonAesthetic: lightless deeps, sight without light, soft-footed, everything felt not seen
umbral.palette: near-black, cold indigo, faint bioluminescent teal
umbral.materials: wet stone, unlit passages, soft cloth
umbral.light: no light source — form implied by touch, edges felt not lit
umbral.people: pale from lightlessness, eyes adapted and over-large, moves without sound. Dark soft cloth, no metal, nothing that catches light. Touches walls and doorframes as they pass.

blazeborn.name: The Blazeborn
blazeborn.canonAesthetic: glass plains, revelation as violence, the burning truth, no shadow permitted
blazeborn.palette: white-gold, glare-blown highlights, no true shadow
blazeborn.people: scorch-marked and unbothered by it — singed hair, burn-scarred forearms worn openly. Bright, hard-wearing cloth with the edges gone black. Runs hot: sleeves off in cold weather. Restless hands, quick to gesture, stands too close to fires.

rootkin.name: The Rootkin
rootkin.canonAesthetic: grown not built, green-heart, sap and bark and slow enormous patience
rootkin.light: green-filtered canopy light, slow and warm
rootkin.people: green under the nails, seeds and burrs on the cloth. Weathered, strong, patient. Hair grown long and left. Barefoot as often as not.

ashwarden.name: The Ashwardens
ashwarden.canonAesthetic: grey ash-fields, the mercy of stopping, quiet keepers of last things
ashwarden.palette: greys, bone-white, faded charcoal, a single quiet ember
ashwarden.light: low, level, the grey light of a still morning
ashwarden.mood: the mercy of stopping — solemn, tender, kept
ashwarden.people: grey, plainly dressed, unhurried. Hands calm and clean. Older than they look or younger than they act. Carries a keeper's tools; wears no ornament.

marcher.name: The Marchers
marcher.canonAesthetic: honed steel, the line that holds, scars worn as record
marcher.materials: honed blades, scarred armor, the held line
marcher.light: hard edge-light, a blade catching the sun
marcher.people: armoured or half-armoured even off duty, and the armour is USED — repaired plate, a worn strap line across the chest. Watchful at doorways and edges. Carries a weapon as an ordinary object. Weather on the face; the settled stance of someone who has held a line and expects to again.

stillhold.name: The Stillhold
stillhold.canonAesthetic: white walls, unbroken quiet, a peace that has forgotten why it was needed
stillhold.materials: smooth plaster, unbroken walls, empty rooms
stillhold.light: even, sourceless, a quiet that has forgotten its reason
stillhold.mood: unbroken peace, almost eerie in its calm
stillhold.people: very still. Plain, symmetrical dress. Face composed to the point of unreadability. Nothing carried, nothing fidgeting.

somatic.name: The Somatics
somatic.canonAesthetic: breath and sinew, movement as speech, the body as the only instrument
somatic.materials: breath, sinew, bare movement, no tools
somatic.light: warm side-light modelling muscle and motion
somatic.mood: the body as the only instrument — kinetic, present
somatic.people: visible economy of movement — nothing wasted, weight always centred. Practical dress, sleeves bound. Old joint injuries.

cogitant.name: The Cogitants
cogitant.canonAesthetic: thin bodies, vast interiors, memory-palaces, thought as force
cogitant.materials: thin frames, vast implied interiors, memory-palaces
cogitant.light: dim, inward, the glow of thought not sun
cogitant.mood: still body, immense interior — thought as force
cogitant.people: unkempt in the way of someone who forgot. Ink, notes, hair unattended. Eyes intensely present or entirely absent. Thin.

churnfolk.name: The Churnfolk
churnfolk.canonAesthetic: improvised everything, luck-riding, nothing twice, joyous mess
churnfolk.materials: improvised gear, patched cloth, lucky junk
churnfolk.mood: joyous mess, luck-riding, never twice the same
churnfolk.people: mismatched, patched, cheerful. Charms, dice, lucky things. Weathered and quick. Something about them is always slightly wrong and never the same thing twice.

lattice.name: The Lattice-Cities
lattice.canonAesthetic: arcologies, perfect prediction, the binding of possibility, no accident permitted
lattice.materials: arcology glass, seamless alloy, no accident
lattice.light: flat perfect illumination, no unplanned shadow
lattice.mood: total prediction, the binding of possibility
lattice.people: exactly dressed, everything squared. Carries a record. Reads a room in order, left to right. Nothing improvised.

enginewright.name: The Enginewrights
enginewright.canonAesthetic: gear-teeth and pressure, systems all the way down, the Precursor arts at their most technical
enginewright.light: forge-glow and gauge-light, systems all the way down
enginewright.mood: technical, dense, mechanical to the core
enginewright.people: burn-marks, oil, tools worn where the hand falls. Goggles pushed up. Squints at mechanisms rather than at people.

numinous.name: The Numinous
numinous.canonAesthetic: thinning veils, meaning without matter, the mystic disciplines the Valley only rumors
numinous.materials: almost nothing — meaning without matter, thinning veils
numinous.light: a light with no source, the mystic rumor
numinous.people: eyes that focus slightly past you. Thin, often underfed — attending the veil costs. Wears charms, thresholds, small warding things. Stands near doorways.

threnodist.name: The Threnodists
threnodist.canonAesthetic: tidal, expressive, public weeping and public joy, architecture shaped for feeling
threnodist.materials: flowing cloth, water, architecture shaped for feeling
threnodist.mood: public weeping and public joy — tidal, expressive
threnodist.people: marked by grief kept rather than resolved — dark cloth, mourning tokens worn long past custom. A carrying voice even in silence.

syllogist.name: The Syllogists
syllogist.canonAesthetic: clean lines, argument as architecture, the cold pleasure of a proof
syllogist.palette: clean white, single ink-black line, cold blue
syllogist.light: even and clear, the cold pleasure of a proof
syllogist.people: clean, spare, attentive. Listens with the whole face. Carries the wrong book for the occasion. Interrupts precisely.

veilwright.name: The Veilwrights
veilwright.canonAesthetic: mirrors and masks, nothing quite where it appears, hospitality you cannot trust
veilwright.materials: mirrors, masks, surfaces that aren't where they seem
veilwright.light: reflected and doubled — you can't trust the source
veilwright.mood: beautiful, untrustworthy, nothing quite where it appears
veilwright.people: pleasant, forgettable, well-dressed for wherever they are. Nothing distinctive, deliberately. You would not describe them the same way twice.

verist.name: The Verists
verist.canonAesthetic: unadorned stone, no ornament, a truth that does not care whether you can bear it
verist.palette: raw stone-grey, no ornament, honest brown
verist.materials: unadorned stone, plain wood, nothing decorative
verist.light: flat honest daylight, no flattering angle
verist.mood: a truth that doesn't care whether you can bear it
verist.people: plain to the point of severity. Direct eye contact. No ornament, no softening. Looks like someone about to say the thing.

abyssal.name: The Abyssal Choir
abyssal.canonAesthetic: horned architecture, bargains, an honesty about appetite the pious lack
abyssal.materials: horned architecture, bargain-marks, appetite made stone
abyssal.light: low red glow from below, honest about hunger
abyssal.mood: frank appetite, bargains, an honesty the pious lack
abyssal.people: hollow-cheeked, appetite showing. Dark wet-looking cloth. Too still, then too fast. Something behind the eyes is listening.

seraphic.name: The Seraphic Orders
seraphic.canonAesthetic: tiered spires, unbearable choral certainty, mercy administered from above
seraphic.light: radiant from above, unbearable choral certainty
seraphic.people: upright, ordered, unornamented. Clean lines and clean cloth. Regards people as though weighing them, because they are.

mason.name: The Masons of the Given
mason.canonAesthetic: stone, weight, ledgers, a deep suspicion of anything that cannot be weighed
mason.materials: cut stone, weight, ledgers, the measured and provable
mason.mood: suspicious of anything unweighable — grounded, dense
mason.people: heavy through the shoulders, stone-dust in the creases. Blunt hands. Plain, durable, unfashionable. Stands like a thing that will not move.

figurist.name: The Figurists
figurist.canonAesthetic: impossible geometry, buildings that are arguments, a place that resists being mapped
figurist.materials: impossible geometry, buildings that are arguments
figurist.light: light that bends wrong, a place resisting the map
figurist.people: precise, spare, slightly abstracted. Geometric ornament worn without warmth. Draws in the air while thinking.

horizon.name: The Horizon-Walkers
horizon.canonAesthetic: tents and roads, distance as home, a people with no fixed anything
horizon.materials: tents, roads, distance itself as home
horizon.mood: no fixed anything — distance as home
horizon.people: road-worn, sun-marked, travelling light. Boots better than the rest of the outfit. Never quite settled in a chair.

hourkeeper.name: The Hourkeepers
hourkeeper.canonAesthetic: clock-towers, archives that run forward, an unbearable patience
hourkeeper.materials: clock-towers, forward-running archives, gears of time
hourkeeper.light: the patient light of a long-kept room
hourkeeper.mood: unbearable patience, time held and counted
hourkeeper.people: aged unevenly — young hands, old eyes, or the reverse. Carries a count. Unhurried past the point of comfort.

unmaker.name: The Unmakers
unmaker.canonAesthetic: controlled ruin, beautiful demolitions, an ethic of clearing
unmaker.materials: beautiful demolition, ordered ruin, the cleared space
unmaker.light: light entering a thing just opened
unmaker.mood: an ethic of clearing — ruin made beautiful and deliberate
unmaker.people: neat, minimal, watchful. Carries very little and each thing exact. Looks at structures rather than people. Nothing decorative anywhere.

wright.name: The Wrights of the New
wright.canonAesthetic: scaffolds forever, half-built cathedrals, the joy and the waste of it
wright.materials: scaffolds forever, half-built cathedrals, tools mid-use
wright.light: work-light on the unfinished, the joy and waste of it
wright.mood: never finished, and that's the point — becoming
wright.people: covered in the work — sawdust, mortar, half-finished things in the pockets. Sleeves shoved up. Building something even while talking.

bargainers.name: The Bargainers
bargainers.canonAesthetic: tables, ledgers, terms named aloud and kept exactly; a gift that costs precisely what was said
bargainers.materials: ledger paper, wax seals, split tally-sticks, a plain table
bargainers.light: a single lamp between two parties, everything outside the circle of it unlit
bargainers.mood: unhurried, exact, courteous — the calm of someone who has already named the price
bargainers.people: plainly and neatly dressed, nothing ostentatious — ostentation is a claim you have not yet earned. Hands are the focus: open, empty, offered. Carries a tally-stick, a folded ledger, or nothing at all. Composed, attentive, unembarrassed. Never predatory — a Bargainer who LOOKS like a trap is a bad Bargainer.

god_named.name: The God-Named
god_named.canonAesthetic: a borrowed name worn openly; authority that is entirely real and entirely unverifiable
god_named.palette: bleached linen, old gold leaf, dust-white, deep shadowed umber
god_named.materials: worn vestments, a carried sigil, sun-faded cloth, stone thresholds
god_named.light: high and behind — the face partly shadowed by the light it claims to carry
god_named.mood: upright, weathered, certain in a way that has cost something
god_named.people: bears the name visibly — a sigil, a stole, a brand, a stance. Often tired underneath the bearing. The name is grander than the person and that gap SHOWS: fine device, plain body; great title, mended hem. Never radiant of themselves — the light is borrowed and the borrowing is the point.

radiant_folk.name: Radiant working
radiant_folk.palette: white-gold core, hard cyan edge, black cast shadows with knife borders
radiant_folk.materials: prism, polished sun-metal, braided light-guide, scorched surfaces
radiant_folk.light: ⛔ THE LIGHT IS THE SUBJECT — coherent beams, caustics, hard shadow with no falloff
radiant_folk.mood: precise, silent, instantaneous. Clean scorch lines rather than fire.
radiant_folk.signature: a straight beam that does not diffuse; caustic patterns thrown on nearby stone
radiant_folk._note: ⚠️ DISTINCT FROM BLAZEBORN `Radiance`, which is revelation-as-violence and overexposed. This is light as a TOOL — focused, cold-edged, engineered.
radiant_folk._movedFrom:
⛔ SNG-530. This palette lived under `powerSystems.radiant` and radiant IS NOT A POWER SOURCE — it is a foothill. ⚠️ `aestheticFor` resolves traditions[t] THEN powerSystems[ps], so a radiant_folk craft was reaching its own palette by accident: its `powerSystem` happened to spell the same word as its people.
⛔ THAT ACCIDENT IS WHAT BLOCKED CCODE-217. With the ability's own powerSystem winning, `radiant_folk` crafts resolve `precursor` and paint as precursor — 300 crafts silently repainted, caught by the §C3 gate because it asserts WHICH palette rather than whether one.

harmonic.name: Harmonic working
harmonic.palette: pale slate and bone-white, thin bands of amber where a wave stands
harmonic.materials: phononic crystal, tuned stone, taut cable, glass that rings
harmonic.light: even and sourceless — the air itself is patterned; visible interference rings and standing-wave shells
harmonic.mood: ⛔ ORDERED AND FELT BEFORE SEEN — pressure, not glare. The picture should suggest a sound you can stand inside.
harmonic.signature: concentric rings, nodal lines, dust settling into pattern on a flat surface

valley_craft.name: Valley craft
valley_craft.palette: ⛔ MUTED EARTH — wool, leather, wet rope, iron. NO EMISSIVE COLOUR AT ALL.
valley_craft.materials: hand tools, plain cloth, worn wood, honest metal
valley_craft.light: ordinary daylight, lamplight, firelight. Whatever is actually there.
valley_craft.mood: ⚠️ THE ABSENCE OF SPECTACLE IS THE POINT. Wayfinding, greenlore, a mediator's tongue — these are people being GOOD AT SOMETHING, and the image must not imply a power system.
valley_craft.signature: hands doing work, close in, no effect layer over the top

_powerSystemNote:
⛔ SNG-435 §C3. FIVE ABILITY GROUPS FALL BACK TO THE DEFAULT PALETTE, AND THEY ARE NOT PEOPLES. Measured: 55 of 376 abilities carry a `tradition` value that does not exist in traditions.json — `harmonic` (15), `valley_craft` (17), `radiant_folk` (14), `precursor` (6), `cross_pole_braid` (3).
⚠️ IN EVERY CASE THE VALUE IS THE ABILITY'S `powerSystem`, NOT A CULTURE: harmonic→powerSystem `harmonic`, radiant_folk→`radiant`, precursor→`precursor`, valley_craft→`valley_craft`, and the three braids each carry a different `reach_*`. THE `tradition` FIELD IS HOLDING A POWER SOURCE.
⛔ SO AUTHORING FIVE `traditions` ENTRIES WOULD INVENT FIVE PEOPLES THE WORLD DOES NOT HAVE — the same error as SNG-432, where `harmonic_radiant` turned out to be a disposition pair and `valley_craft_administration` a job description. They are authored below under `powerSystems` instead.
⚠️ AND THIS AXIS IS THE BETTER ONE ANYWAY: what a harmonic craft LOOKS like comes from SOUND, not from a people. A tradition supplies CULTURE; a power system supplies PHYSICS. Resolve `powerSystems[ps]` first for these, `traditions[t]` for the other 321.
⛔ SNG-530: THIS BLOCK IS FOR POWER SOURCES ONLY — precursor, ordered_nanite, wild_nanite, metaphysical, and `braid` for combinations. ⚠️ A PEOPLE'S PALETTE GOES IN `traditions`, KEYED BY THE PEOPLE.

precursor.name: Precursor working
precursor.palette: dull graphite and verdigris, with one line of cold blue where the lattice wakes
precursor.materials: buried alloy, seamless joins, geometry too regular to be grown or built
precursor.light: ⚠️ NOTHING GLOWS UNTIL IT IS ROUSED, and then only in lines — light travels ALONG a path rather than filling a space
precursor.mood: old, indifferent, still working. Not magical — MAINTAINED.
precursor.signature: a single line of light running away into the dark along a buried course

braid.name: Cross-pole braid
braid.palette: the two parent palettes meeting WITHOUT blending — a seam, not a gradient
braid.materials: whatever both parents use, in contact
braid.light: two light logics in one frame, and the boundary between them is the subject
braid.mood: ⛔ HELD, NOT RESOLVED. A braid is a tension sustained; if the image looks harmonious it is wrong.
braid.signature: a visible seam where two different physics meet and neither wins
braid._note: ⚠️ Braids are MINTED AT RUNTIME, so this entry must generalise. Read the two parent reaches from `powerSystem` and compose; do not author per-braid.

_sng530:
⛔ SNG-530, CCODE'S BLOCKER, RULED. The `powerSystems` palette block held FIVE keys and only ONE was a power source. `radiant` and `harmonic` are FOOTHILLS; `valley_craft` is a FOLK COLLECTION; `braid` is a COMBINATION. ⚠️ THE SAME CATEGORY ERROR I CLEARED FROM 321 ABILITY RECORDS, surviving one file over in the palette map.
⛔ THREE MOVED TO `traditions`, KEYED BY THE PEOPLE THEY BELONG TO — `radiant` → `radiant_folk`. Now a radiant craft reaches its palette BY ITS TRADITION, which is what it always meant, and its `powerSystem` is free to be `precursor` without repainting it.
⚠️ `braid` AND `precursor` STAY IN `powerSystems`: precursor IS a source, and a braid has no single people — those two are the block being used correctly.
⛔ CCODE-217 IS UNBLOCKED. Flip the loader; the ability wins and the header fills the gap.
